references.title: MIT 18.06 Linear Algebra
references.notes: Core undergraduate matrix theory and linear algebra: systems, vector spaces, determinants, eigenvalues, similarity, positive definite matrices, and applications.

references.title: MIT 18.06SC Linear Algebra
references.notes: Independent-study presentation with lectures, problem sets, exams, and the Ax=b/four-subspaces sequence.

references.title: Linear Algebra Done Right, 4th ed.
references.notes: Proof-oriented treatment emphasizing vector spaces, linear maps, invariant subspaces, eigenstructure, inner-product spaces, operators, and advanced finite-dimensional theory.

references.title: Introduction to Applied Linear Algebra — Vectors, Matrices, and Least Squares
references.notes: Application-oriented vectors, matrices, least squares, modeling, and computational examples.

references.title: Stanford EE263 — Applied Linear Algebra / Linear Dynamical Systems materials
references.notes: Advanced applied linear algebra centered on y=Ax, least squares, SVD, eigenstructure, dynamical systems, and engineering applications.

references.title: MIT 18.065 Matrix Methods in Data Analysis, Signal Processing, and Machine Learning
references.notes: Matrix methods connecting orthogonality, eigenvalues, positive semidefinite matrices, SVD, optimization, data analysis, signal processing, and machine learning.

references.title: Numerical Linear Algebra, Twenty-fifth Anniversary Edition
references.authority: Lloyd N. Trefethen and David Bau III / SIAM
references.notes: Canonical numerical linear algebra treatment of orthogonalization, conditioning, stability, linear systems, eigenproblems, Krylov methods, and numerical algorithms.

references.title: Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd ed.
references.notes: Detailed reference for floating-point error, conditioning, backward error, and numerical stability.

references.title: LAPACK Documentation and Users' Guide
references.notes: Reference implementation/documentation for dense linear systems, least squares, eigenvalue problems, SVD, and standard factorizations.

references.title: Matrix Computations, 4th ed.
references.authority: Gene H. Golub and Charles F. Van Loan / Johns Hopkins University Press
references.notes: Comprehensive matrix algorithm reference spanning factorizations, least squares, eigenproblems, sparse/iterative techniques, and implementation concerns.

references.title: Matrix Analysis, 2nd ed.
references.authority: Roger A. Horn and Charles R. Johnson / Cambridge University Press
references.notes: Second-course and graduate matrix analysis reference with canonical forms, spectral theory, matrix inequalities, and advanced structure.

references.title: Finding Structure with Randomness: Probabilistic Algorithms for Constructing Approximate Matrix Decompositions
references.authority: N. Halko, P.-G. Martinsson, J. A. Tropp / SIAM Review
references.notes: Foundational survey/framework for randomized low-rank matrix approximation and randomized numerical linear algebra.

references.title: Tensor Decompositions and Applications
references.authority: Tamara G. Kolda and Brett W. Bader / SIAM Review
references.notes: Canonical survey of higher-order tensor decompositions, algorithms, applications, and software.

references.title: Randomized Linear Algebra in Scientific Computing
references.notes: Recent overview of randomized/sketched linear algebra directions in scientific computing; used only for frontier orientation, not as a substitute for primary literature.

references.title: Vector addition.svg
references.notes: Public-domain visual reference embedded in LA-0004 to show head-to-tail/parallelogram vector addition. Direct media: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/28/Vector_addition.svg
